text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to enable quiet-7b-v2 in the catalog during tonight's 23:00-01:00 change window. Canary 3% initially.
ryan: 👍 what's the fallback ordering? we should avoid routing to quiet-6b-quant unless absolutely needed.
maria: typo — meant 'maria'. Fallback order will be [quiet-7b-v1, quiet-7b-v1-quant-lite, quiet-6b-quant]. prefer v1 before quant variants.
ryan: ok. can we pin eu-prod to v1 for the first 2 hours? EU latency sensitivity + regional GPUs.
maria: yes, will add pin for `eu-prod` and `internal-prod`.
deploy-bot: deploybot: catalog.enable requested by @maria for model quiet-7b-v2 -> scheduled at 2024-05-06T23:00Z (thread 1715298765). Canary 3%.
sophie: quick obs: recent memory pressure incidents tied to kv-cache growth on long context. If we hit NodeMemory > 78% for 3 nodes, auto-roll back to v1. Put that in the guardrail.
ryan: agree. Add metric triggers: p95 latency +20% from baseline OR err_rate >= 0.8% over 2 mins -> rollback.
maria: noted. I'll add to the enable config and release notes. Also setting observability check: sampling prompts from our smoke set every minute for canary.
d an: how long is the drain window on rollback? we should avoid instant swap for stateful sessions.
maria: drain will be 60s for new connections, KV warmup allowed 3 mins. Fallback ladder is immediate routing to next variant; sessions with active KV will get best-effort preserved for 2 mins.
sophie: add an ops-bot alert to page on rollback trigger (pager after automated attempt). no silent rollbacks.
ops-bot: ops-bot: configured alert `catalog.enable.rollback` -> pages on SEV2 when triggered.
ryan: small config snippet for the record: ```
catalog_enable:
  model: quiet-7b-v2
  canary: 3%
  fallback_order: ["quiet-7b-v1", "quiet-7b-v1-quant-lite", "quiet-6b-quant"]
  pinlist: ["internal-prod", "eu-prod"]
  rollback_triggers:
    - p95_latency_pct_increase: 20
    - error_rate_pct: 0.8
    - node_memory_percent: 78
  drain_seconds: 60
```
maria: thanks. I'll attach that to the release notes and the deploybot request.
deploy-bot: deploybot: enable job created. preflight checks: model artifacts validated (sha256 OK), runtime compatibility checks passed, safety evals green. Ready for schedule.
dan: what's our post-cutover telemetry cadence? we should spike dashboards to 30s resolution for first 15 mins.
maria: will do. Also adding a short rollback playbook link in the release note: https://intra.redwood/release-playbooks/quiet-7b-v2-rollback
sophie: quick ask — can we deprioritize fallback to quiet-6b-quant for samples flagged as 'high-quality' by our reranker? don't want noisy quant outputs for premium tier.
ryan: yes, implement routing policy: if req.metadata.quality == "premium" -> skip quiet-6b-quant in fallback.
maria: added. That's in the config too.
ops-bot: ops-bot: reminder — change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Please confirm blockers by 21:30 UTC.
ryan: no blockers from infra. slot reservations done.
sophie: I'll be on call until 01:30.
dan: I'll stand by for rollback steps.
maria: final note for release notes: user-impact: slightly revised tokenization (token-level parity with v1), expected p50/p95 similar. Canary telemetry will validate.
ryan: 👍 publish release note after midnight if canary looks good.
deploy-bot: deploybot: at 2024-05-06T23:00Z — enable started (3% canary). Job id: cb-1715298765-01.
maria: canary observed - no regressions so far, p95 within +3%.
sophie: sampling smoke set looks clean. keeping 30s dashboards.
deploy-bot: deploybot: canary progressed to 15% at 2024-05-06T23:18Z per scheduled ramp.
ryan: watching error budget, no spikes.
manual-checks: (reaction :white_check_mark:)
maria: decision point at 23:45 — if green, progress to 50%. If any rollback trigger hit, follow playbook.
sophie: ack.
ops-bot: ops-bot: setting temporary retention for canary logs -> 72h.
deploy-bot: deploybot: full enable to 50% at 2024-05-06T23:46Z.
ryan: monitoring. all clear so far.
forgotten: this thread should also list rollback owner — @dan will own manual rollback ops.
dan: acknowledged. I'll execute `catalog.disable --model quiet-7b-v2 --reason "rollback-triggered"` if needed and coordinate pins.
maria: after cutoff window ends at 01:00, we'll remove eu-prod pin at 02:30 unless we see any anomalies.
sophie: small follow-up: please add note for support that model variant v1 and quant-lite are expected fallbacks for embedded customers.
maria: added to release notes.
ryan: thanks team. rolling retrospective scheduled tomorrow 10:00 to capture lessons.
ops-bot: ops-bot: incident channel will be created automatically if rollback fires.
deploy-bot: deploybot: enable job cb-1715298765-01 completed at 2024-05-07T00:55Z; final state: ENABLED (50%).
maria: closing thread — document stored: https://intra.redwood/releases/quiet-7b-v2-canary-report
ryan: nice, good rollout :tada:
